result.title: RIT-RAG: Navigating Document Corpora with Retrieval-Induced Trees
result.comment: 24 pages (main text through Limitations ends on page 9, followed by references and appendix), 9 figures, 16 tables
result.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in external corpora. Agentic RAG enables iterative search, yet exposes the model to isolated chunks without document structure, making it difficult to distinguish relevant evidence from chunks that merely resemble the query. Structure-aware methods such as PageIndex navigate document structure but cannot scale to the structures of large corpora, which do not fit in the LLM context. Hence, they first commit to a single document using a document retriever and cannot recover from a wrong choice. We propose RIT-RAG (Retrieval-Induced Tree RAG), which combines content retrieval with structural navigation. Offline, RIT-RAG builds a tree for each document from its table of contents or sitemap. At query time, it retrieves a broad set of chunks and uses their positions to induce manageable sub-trees, potentially across multiple documents. An LLM agent navigates these sub-trees, selectively reads promising nodes, and reformulates queries when needed. Thus, retrieval proposes where to look, while the agent decides what to read. Across financial, scientific, and customer-support benchmarks, RIT-RAG achieves the highest answer accuracy among vanilla, graph-based, and agentic baselines. On EntQABench, our new benchmark of 2.84 million technical-documentation webpages, it improves accuracy by 6.8 to 11.4 points over the strongest baseline across three LLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RIT-RAG：离线按目录或站点地图为每篇文档建树，查询时用检索到的 chunks 位置诱导出可管理的子树，再由 LLM agent 在树中导航、选择性读取节点并按需改写查询，在金融、科学、客服等基准上取得最高准确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「检索提议看哪里、agent 决定读什么」的稀疏证据选择与按需停止/改查机制，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、动态计算与停止决策提供可核查的方法线索；但原文属纯文本检索场景，迁移到多模态 latent 状态尚需验证。
